ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key — get it at console.anthropic.com/settings/api-keys

JOBFLOW_LICENSE_KEY.description: Your JobFlow license key from your purchase email (JWT format). Leave blank to start your 7-day free trial.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Password to protect your private JobFlow instance — your browser will prompt for it on first visit

DATA_PROVIDER.description: Storage backend: json (default, ephemeral), sheets (persistent), or supabase (persistent)

LICENSE_SIGNING_SECRET.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to verify license JWTs — must match the key used to generate licenses
